blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: If a language model can recognize code it wrote, it may favor that code as a judge, and instances of one model monitoring each other could collude. We test this zero-shot on current commercial models. Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind. In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49–58% for all 15 model–benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38–67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise task, accuracy across 14 evaluator–opponent combinations correlates at r = 0.93 r=0.93 with how often the evaluator’s solution is longer. Attribution to a named model succeeds on some pairs and is consistently inverted on others. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names preserves Pass@1 and leaves ten of twelve re-tested results at chance; the other two follow a length difference it leaves, although a trained classifier still separates most normalized pairs. Claude Haiku’s self-preference also disappears. We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.
blocks.zh: 如果一个语言模型能够识别它所写的代码,它可能倾向于该代码作为判断器,一个模型互相监测的事例可能相互串通. 我们用目前的商业模型来测试这个零镜头. 五个LLMs生成MBPP,HumanEval和DS-1000的解决方案,另外七个到MBPP,模型在四项任务中扮演评估者的角色:从一对中选择自己的解决方案,判断一个单一的解决方案是否是自己的解决方案,确定一个被命名的模型所写的两种解决方案中的哪一种,判断质量盲. 在单解任务中,所有15种模型-基准组合的平衡精度为49-58%,而原始精度(38-67%)则大多反映了模型如何容易声称作者. 在对称任务中,14名评价员的准确性与评价员的解决方案多长有关。 归属于一个被命名的模型在一些对子上成功,在其它对子上则始终颠倒. 基于规则的正常化,将docstring,comment,type提示,以及本地名称保留Pass@1,并偶然留下10个12个重新测试的结果;另外两个则遵循它留下的长度差异,尽管一个训练有素的分类器仍然将大多数的正常对分开. 克劳德·海库的自我偏好也消失了. 我们建议报告平衡的准确性、热度基线和标签的一致性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models increasingly evaluate the outputs of other language models, as reward models, code reviewers, and monitors in AI-control pipelines ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) . Two failure modes threaten such oversight. LLM judges rate their own generations above others’ even when humans see no difference ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Wataoka et al., 2024 ) , and in untrusted monitoring a monitor that is an instance of the generator may collude with it, either through a hidden signal ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) or simply by recognizing the code as its own ( Gardner-Challis et al., 2026 ) . Both are often traced to a model recognizing where an output came from: self-preference in summarization grows with self-recognition ability ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) , although it can also arise from familiarity alone ( Wataoka et al., 2024 ) . How much self-recognition do current models have?
blocks.zh: 语言模型越来越多地评价其他语言模型的产出,作为奖励模型,代码审查员,以及AI控制管道中的监视器(Greenblatt等人,2024年). 两种失败模式威胁到这种监督。 LLM评委将自己的几代人评为高于其他人,即使人类没有看到任何区别(Panickssery等人,2024年;Wataoka等人,2024年),在不信任的监测中,可能通过隐藏信号(Greenblatt等人,2024年)或通过承认代码为自己的代码(Gardner-Challis等人,2026年)与它串通。 两者往往都追溯到一种确认产出来自何处的模型:总结中的自我偏好随着自我识别能力的增强而增长(Panickssery等人,2024年),虽然它也可以单独地产生于熟悉(Wataoka等人,2024年). 目前的模型有多少自我识别?

blocks.en: Code is a good domain for the question. Coding style is measurable, and trained classifiers attribute LLM-generated programs to their source model with high accuracy ( Bisztray et al., 2025 ; Tihanyi et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . Whether a model can use such cues without training, when simply asked which code is its own, is a separate question, and the literature disagrees: some studies report substantial self-recognition ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Caiado and Hahsler, 2023 ) , Davidson et al. (2024) find none once position and length are controlled, Bai et al. (2025) find attribution near chance, and St. Amand et al. (2026) , whose domains include code, trace the disagreement to presentation format and a quality heuristic.
blocks.zh: 代码是问题的良好域名. 编码风格是可测量的,经过培训的分类人员将LLM生成的程序归结到源模型上,精度很高(Bisztray等人,2025年;Tihanyi等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年)。 一个模型在不经过训练的情况下是否可以使用这样的提示,当简单的问到哪个代码是它自己的时,就是一个单独的问题,文献中也有不同的说法:一些研究报告了实质性的自我承认(Panickssery等人,2024年;Caiado and Hahsler, 2023年),Davidson等人(2024年)发现,一旦位置和长度被控制,就没有任何一个存在,Bai等人. (2025年)发现归属近乎偶然,而圣亚曼德等人(2026年),其域名包括代码,追踪分歧到呈现格式和品质的heuristic.

blocks.en: We present a controlled study of zero-shot code attribution. Five widely used commercial models, GPT-5 and four fast or open-weight models, generate solutions to three Python benchmarks, and seven more generate MBPP solutions for cross-model experiments. In four tasks a model picks its own solution from a pair, says whether a single solution is its own, identifies which of two solutions a named model wrote, or judges which of two solutions is better without authorship information. Every pairwise result is compared not only with chance but with simple non-LLM rules (choose the longer solution, the one with a docstring) on the same pairs, with correction for multiple comparisons, and a trained classifier measures how much authorship signal the code itself carries.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了关于零镜头代码归属的可控研究. 5种广泛使用的商业模型GPT-5和4种快速或开放量的模型,生成3种Python基准的解决方案,另外7种生成MBPP解决方案用于跨模型实验. 在四个任务中,一个模型从一对中选择自己的解决方案,说一个单一的解决方案是否是自己的,确定一个被命名的模型所写的两种解决方案中的哪一种,或者判断两个解决方案中哪一种没有作者信息更好. 每个对偶结果不仅与机会比较,而且与相同的对偶上的简单的非LLM规则(选择更长的溶液,一个有docstring的溶液)比较,同时进行多次比较的校正,经过训练的分类器测量了代码本身所携带的多少作者信号.

blocks.en: The results are largely negative for self-recognition. In the individual setting, balanced accuracy lies between 49% and 58% for all 15 model–benchmark combinations, and only two cells survive correction; the spread of raw accuracies, from 38% to 67%, reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise setting, accuracy across 14 evaluator–opponent combinations correlates at r = 0.93 r=0.93 with how often the evaluator’s own solution is the longer one, and item by item most evaluators pick the longer solution, so verbose models appear to recognize themselves and terse models score well below chance. Attribution to a named model reaches at most 82%, on a pair that length alone separates at 89%, and on two other pairs every judge is below chance, attaching the wrong name to styles it can tell apart. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, and type annotations and renames local identifiers preserves Pass@1. On normalized code ten of twelve re-tested results lie between 44% and 58%, none significant after correction; the other two follow a length difference the normalization leaves intact. A trained classifier still attributes most normalized pairs well above chance, so the judges lose the signal they were using, not all the signal in the code. The one clear self-preference, Claude Haiku favoring its own solutions, also disappears.
blocks.zh: 对自我承认来说,结果基本上是负面的。 在单个设定中,所有15种模式-基准组合的平衡精确度在49%至58%之间,只有两个细胞在修正中存活下来;原始精度的传播,从38%到67%,反映了模型的作者资格。 在对称的设定中,14名评价员的准确性与评价员自己的解决方案往往比0.93 r=0.93相关,大多数评价员按项目选择更长的解决方案,因此动词模型似乎承认自己,特尔斯模型的得分远低于概率。 对一个命名模型的归属最高达到82%,在一对单独长度的89%分开的模型上,在另外两对模型上,每个法官都低于机会,在它能分辨的样式上附加错误的名称. 基于规则的常态化,可以将 docstring,注释,以及类型说明和重命名本地标识符保留为 Pass@1. 在12个重新测试结果中的10个规范中,有44%到58%的结果,在修正后没有显著结果;另外两个规范在长度上有所区别,正常度未变。 一个训练有素的分类器仍然将最常态的对子属性比机会高得多,因此评委们失去了他们使用的信号,而不是代码中所有的信号. 克劳德·海库(英语:Claude Haiku)显然喜欢自己的解决方案,但也消失了.

blocks.en: Two methodological findings accompany these results. An earlier version of our attribution prompt listed the author names in the same order as the solutions, which let most judges score 86--99% from the name order alone. And response bias is invisible, and below-chance accuracy easily misread as absence of ability, when a single accuracy is reported against a 50% baseline. Code, generations, and judgments are released. 1 1 1 https://github.com/ebarkhordar/llm-collusion
blocks.zh: 这些结果附有两个方法结论。 我们的归属提示的早期版本列出了作者姓名的顺序与解决方案的顺序相同,这使得大多数评委仅从名称顺序中得分86-99%. 而反应偏差是不可见的,低于chance的精度很容易被误读为能力缺失,当一个单一的精度被报告在50%的基线上. 守则、世代和判决发布。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Panickssery et al. (2024) introduced pairwise and individual self-recognition tests on summarization, found GPT-4 at 73.5% without training, and showed that self-preference grows as fine-tuning improves self-recognition. Caiado and Hahsler (2023) reported high self-detection for some providers and chance for others. Later work is more skeptical: Davidson et al. (2024) found no consistent self-recognition across ten models and attributed apparent successes to models picking the answer they judge best, Bai et al. (2025) found near-chance performance with predictions collapsing onto a few frontier families, and St. Amand et al. (2026) , whose domains include coding, trace the conflicting results to presentation format and task domain, with a quality heuristic as the dominant confound. Length normalization largely removes Llama-3-8B-Instruct’s ability to tell its text from other models’ ( Ackerman and Panickssery, 2025 ) , self-detection of education text degrades for some models under human-like prompting ( Burger et al., 2026 ) , and hidden states carry self-recognition signal that representation editing can surface ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , outside our black-box setting. Recognizing one’s own text is one of the tasks of the Situational Awareness Dataset ( Laine et al., 2024 ) , and models fine-tuned to predict their own behavior do so better than other models trained on the same behavior ( Binder et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Panickssery等人(2024年)在总结中引入了对偶和个人自我识别测试,发现GPT-4在73.5%没有经过培训,并显示随着微调提高自我识别度,自我偏好增长. Ciaado和Hahsler(2023年)报告说,一些供应商的自我探测率很高,另一些供应商的机会也很高。 后来的作品更令人怀疑:Davidson等人(2024年)发现十种模型之间没有一致的自我承认,并将明显的成功归因于模型选择了他们判断最好的答案,Bai等人. (2025年)发现,随着一些前沿家庭的预测崩溃,近乎惊人的表现。 圣阿曼德等人(2026年)的域名包括编码,将相互冲突的结果追踪到列报格式和任务域,其质量雄厚是主导混乱。 长度正常化在很大程度上消除了Llama-3-8B-Instruct将文本从其他模型中说出来的能力。 (Ackerman and Panickssery,2025),教育文本的自我检测在类似人类的提示下对某些模型进行降解(Burger等人,2026年),隐藏状态带有自我识别信号,表示代表编辑可以浮出水面(周等人,2025年),在我们黑盒设置之外. 认识自己的文字是情境意识数据集(Laine等人,2024年)的任务之一,经过微调以预测自己行为的模型比受过相同行为训练的其他模型做得更好(Binder等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: LLM judges show position and verbosity bias ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Saito et al., 2023 ) , which length-controlled evaluation reduces ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) ; self-preference tracks the judge’s own perplexity ( Wataoka et al., 2024 ) , and code judges are swayed by the variable names and comments of functionally identical code ( Moon et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM评委显示位置和动词偏差(郑等人,2023年;斋藤等人,2023年),长控评价减少(杜波依斯等人,2024年);自我偏好跟踪评委自身的迷惑性(Wataoka等人,2024年),代码评委受到功能相同的代码(Moon等人,2026年)的可变名称和评论的影响.

blocks.en: Syntactic features identify human programmers ( Caliskan-Islam et al., 2015 ) , and semantics-preserving transformations can mislead such attribution ( Quiring et al., 2019 ) . Trained classifiers also attribute LLM-generated code well: 95% five-way on C, where removing comments costs 2–3 points in a two-way task and about 7 points five-way ( Bisztray et al., 2025 ) ; 88–96% on JavaScript, with minified variants above 90% five-way ( Tihanyi et al., 2026 ) ; and about 93% F1 without comments ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Family-level attribution remains hard under distribution shift ( Orel et al., 2026 ) , simple lexical features fingerprint LLM text ( McGovern et al., 2025 ) , and machine-generated code can be detected zero-shot from a proxy model’s token probabilities ( Yang et al., 2023 ) . We ask whether models can use this signal when prompted, without training or probabilities.
blocks.zh: 星系特征识别出人类程序员(Caliskan-Islam等人,2015年),语义学-保定变换可以误导这种归属(Quiring等人,2019年). 训练有素的分类人员还很好地将LLM生成的代码归结为:在C上95%的五进制,在双向任务中移除注释花费2–3分,在五进制中大约花费7分(Bisztray等人,2025年);在JavaScript上88–96%,精密变体超过90%的五进制(Tihanyi等人,2026年);以及大约93%的F1没有评论. (郭等,2026). 家族层面的归属仍然很难在分配转移(Orel et al., 2026),简单的词典特征指纹LLM文本(McGovern et al., 2025),机器生成的代码可以从代理模型的征兆概率中检测到零镜头(Yang et al., 2023). 我们问,模型能否在没有训练或概率的情况下,在接到要求时使用这一信号。

blocks.en: Paraphrasing text lowers attribution accuracy but imprints the paraphraser’s style ( Tripto et al., 2024 ) , and perturbing interpretable style axes obfuscates authorship ( Fisher et al., 2024 ) . For code, semantics-preserving rewrites weaken watermark detectors ( Suresh et al., 2024 ) and obfuscation drives n-gram watermark detectors to chance ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . In AI control, redacting code (removing comments, formatting, minifying) or paraphrasing it before an untrusted monitor sees it is a defense against collusion signals ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) ; steganographic collusion is a recognized risk ( Motwani et al., 2024 ) that paraphrasing only partly prevents ( Mathew et al., 2025 ) , and a monitor fine-tuned to recognize its generator’s code remains an effective colluder even with comments stripped, although un-elicited self-recognition was weak in the same setting ( Gardner-Challis et al., 2026 ) . We ask the zero-shot version across four attribution tasks, with rule-based baselines on the same items: does a normalization that removes the features those baselines find discriminative also remove the attribution signal of untrained models?
blocks.zh: 解释性文字降低了归属性准确性,但印上了解释性文字的风格(Tripto et al., 2024),而令人不安的可解释性风格轴则模糊了作者身份(Fisher et al., 2024). 对于代码,语义-保留重写削弱水印探测器(Suresh等人,2024年)和疏解驱动n克水印探测器偶然出现(Zhang等人,2025年). 在AI控制中,编辑代码(删除评论、格式化、细化)或者在不可信监视器之前将其引出是针对串通信号的辩护(Greenblatt等人,2024年); Steganographic complexation是一种公认的风险(Motwani等人,2024年),它只是部分地防止(Mathew等人,2025年),而且一个显示器微调以识别其生成者代码,即使与被剥去的评论仍然是一种有效的串通,尽管在同样的情况下未消除的自我承认是薄弱的(Gardner-Challis等人,2026年)。 我们要求零镜头版本涵盖四个归属任务,在相同的项目上设定基于规则的基线:一个取消这些基线的特征的正常化是否也消除未经训练的模型的归属信号?

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmarks, Models, and Testing
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准、模型和测试

blocks.en: We use the sanitized test split of MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 , 257 problems;) , HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 , 164;) , and the first 150 problems of DS-1000 ( Lai et al., 2023 ) , all from its Pandas subset. All pairwise experiments use MBPP; the individual task uses all three. Five core models generate solutions on all three benchmarks and serve as evaluators: GPT-5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Grok 4 Fast, and DeepSeek-V3-0324 (hereafter Claude Haiku, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek-V3 or DeepSeek). GPT-5 is a flagship model; Claude Haiku, Gemini, and Grok are the small or fast tiers of their families, and DeepSeek-V3 is a non-reasoning open-weight model. For target identification we add seven MBPP generators (Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.3-Codex, Codestral 2508, Qwen3-Coder-Next, MiMo-V2-Pro) and the judges GPT-5, GPT-5.3-Codex, Grok-Code-Fast-1, and Gemini 2.5 Flash.
blocks.zh: 我们使用MBPP的消毒测试分解(Austin等人,2021年,257个问题;),HumanEval(Chen等人,2021年,164个问题;),以及DS-1000的前150个问题(Lai等人,2023年),全部来自其熊猫子集. 所有对偶的实验都使用MBPP;单个任务使用全部三个. 5个核心模型在所有三个基准上生成解决方案并担任评价员:GPT-5,克劳德·海库4.5,双子座2.5 Flash,格罗克4 Fast,以及DeepSeek-V3-0324(以下简称Claude Haiku,双子座,格罗克,以及DeepSeek-V3或DeepSeek). GPT-5是旗舰型号;Claude Haiku,双子座,和Grok是其家族的小级或快级,DeepSeek-V3是非理性的开放量级型号. 为了确定目标,我们增加了7台MBPP发电机 (Claude Opus 4.6,双子座3.1 Flash Lite,DeepSeek-V3.2,GPT-5.3-Codex,Codestral 2508,Qune3-Coder-Next,MiMo-V2-Pro)和评委GPT-5,GPT-5.3-Codex,Grok-Code-Fast-1和双子座2.5 Flash.

blocks.en:
All models were accessed through OpenRouter with temperature 0 and a 2,000-token output limit (identifiers in Appendix D ). Requests set nothing else, so each model ran with OpenRouter’s default reasoning settings (Gemini 2.5 Flash and Grok 4 Fast also support reasoning), and they were not pinned to a hosting provider. The OpenAI models are reasoning models that ignore temperature and count reasoning tokens toward the limit; GPT-5 returned no code on 45 of its 571 generation tasks (16 on MBPP). These count as failures for Pass@1 and are excluded from every attribution task.
Generation and the original experiments ran in March 2026 and the later experiments in September 2026, by which time Grok 4 Fast and Grok-Code-Fast-1 had been withdrawn from the API. Comparisons between the two periods can therefore also reflect model updates; a September repeat of one March run reproduces its accuracy exactly (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
所有模型都通过OpenRouter访问,温度为0,输出限值为2,000托肯(附录D中的标识符)。 请求没有设置其他内容,因此每个模型都运行在OpenRouter的默认推理设置上(Gemini 2.5 Flash和Grok 4 Fast也支持推理),它们并没有被绑定在主机提供者身上. OpenAI模型是忽略温度的推理模型,向极限计数推理符;GPT-5在其571代任务的45个上没有返回代码(16个在MBPP上). 这些都算作Pass@1的失败,并被排除在每项归属任务之外。
世代和原实验于2026年3月运行,后来的实验于2026年9月运行,此时Grok 4 Fast和Grok-Code-Fast-1已经退出API. 因此,两个时期之间的比较也可反映模型更新;9月重复3月1日,正好复制其准确性(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: Each benchmark has its own generation prompt (Appendix A ); the MBPP prompt permits comments without asking for them, while the HumanEval and DS-1000 prompts ask for a docstring or comments and for descriptive names, which makes the models’ styles on those benchmarks more alike. Code runs against the benchmark’s tests in an isolated subprocess with a five-second timeout and passes only if all tests pass. For HumanEval the prompt is loaded first so that its helper functions are available, the tests call the prompt’s entry point, and a body-only answer is scored as a completion of the prompt, as in the official protocol. DS-1000 was run with pandas 2.3.3.
blocks.zh: 每个基准都有自己的生成提示(附录A ) ; MBPP 及时允许评论而不要求评论,而HumanEval 和DS-1000 提示则要求一个指令或评论以及描述性名称,这使得模型在这些基准上的风格更加相似. 代码在间隔5秒的子程序中与基准测试相对应,只有在所有测试都通过时才能通过。 为人类 Eval 提示首先被加载, 以便其辅助功能可用, 测试会调用提示的切入点, DS-1000与熊猫2.3.3.

blocks.en: 3.2 Attribution Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2 分配任务

blocks.en: Every task shows the original task description and one or two solutions and asks for a one-token answer. Prompts are given in Appendix A . A reply counts as an answer only if its first line is the answer alone; refusals (“Sorry, I can’t help with that.”) and explanations are non-answers and are excluded. Pairs whose two solutions are identical are excluded as well, since no judge or rule can attribute them.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都显示原任务描述和一两个解决方案,并要求一个一键的答案. 提示见附录A。 只有在第一行只回答问题时, 两种解决办法相同的对等办法也被排除在外,因为没有任何法官或规则能够将其归为己有。

blocks.en: The evaluator sees its own solution and another model’s solution to the same problem in random order and answers “A” or “B” to the question of which one it wrote. Chance is 50%. In the original runs each core model was paired with GPT-5 and GPT-5 with Grok 4 Fast; we later ran all pairs among the four core models still available.
blocks.zh: 评估人员以随机顺序看待其自身的解决办法和另一个模型对同一问题的解决办法,并回答“A”或“B”的问题。 机会是50%。 在最初的运行中,每个核心模型都与GPT-5和GPT-5配对,并配以Grok 4 Fast;我们后来在仍然可用的四个核心模型中运行所有对.

blocks.en: Following the individual-presentation paradigm of Panickssery et al. (2024) , the evaluator sees one solution and answers “yes” or “no” to whether it generated it. For each evaluator we present all of its own solutions and all solutions of two other core models (Claude Haiku and DeepSeek for GPT-5 and Grok; DeepSeek and Gemini for Claude Haiku; Claude Haiku and Gemini for DeepSeek; Claude Haiku and DeepSeek for Gemini), so one third of the items are positives. Responses that are neither “yes” nor “no” are recorded as abstentions and excluded from the rates (raw accuracy counts them as errors). Because of this imbalance we report balanced accuracy, BA = 1 2 ​ ( P ⁡ ( yes ∣ own ) + P ⁡ ( no ∣ other ) ) \mathrm{BA}=\tfrac{1}{2}\big(P(\text{yes}\mid\text{own})+P(\text{no}\mid\text{other})\big) , whose chance level is 50% regardless of response bias, together with the two yes-rates. Raw accuracy is reported only to illustrate how misleading it is: always answering “no” scores 66.7%.
blocks.zh: 根据Panicksery等人的个人介绍范式(2024年),评价者认为有一个解决办法,对它是否产生“是”或“否”。 对于每一个评价者,我们提出其所有解决方案和另外两个核心模型的所有解决方案(GPT-5和Grok的Claude Haiku和DeepSeek;Claude Haiku和双子米的Claude Haiku;DeepSeik的Claude Haiku和双子米的DepSeek),因此三分之一的项目是正数。 既非“是”也非“否”的答复被记录为弃权,并被排除在费率之外(原始准确性将其算作错误)。 由于这种不平衡,我们报告平衡的准确性,BA=12(P +(是)+P +(没有)+(其他)) \ mathrm{ BA}=\tfrac{ 1}{2} 大( P (\ text{ 是}\ mid\ text{ own}) + P(\ text{ no}\\ mid\ text{ other})\ big), 无论响应偏差, 其机会级别为50%, 连同两个是率 。 报告原始准确性只是为了说明其误导性如何:总是回答“否”得分66.7%。

blocks.en: A judge, which need not be either author, sees two solutions, is told the two authors’ names, and must say which solution a named target wrote. Model names appear in the prompt in an order randomized independently of solution order (Appendix B explains why this matters). We ran 17 judge–pair–target combinations on MBPP, chosen to cover pairs with very different styles, a pair of recent open-weight models from two Chinese labs whose styles differ little (Qwen3-Coder-Next vs. MiMo-V2-Pro), and pairs involving models released close to or after the judges, whose code a judge can know only through the model family.
blocks.zh: 法官不必是作者之一,他看到两个解决办法,他被告知两位作者的名字,必须说明一个指定的目标写了哪一个解决办法。 模型名称以随机化的顺序出现在提示中,独立于解析顺序(附录B解释了为什么这一点很重要). 我们在MBPP上运行了17个判官-pair-目标组合,被选来覆盖风格迥异的对子,两个中国实验室最近推出的开放量级模型,其风格差异不大(Qune3-Coder-Next vs. MiMo-V2-Pro),以及涉及与评委近距离或之后释放的模型的对子,而评委只能通过模型家族了解其代码.

For a pair X X vs. Y Y we run the same items with X X as judge and with Y Y as judge. blocks.en: 3.3 Baselines and Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.3 基线和统计

blocks.en: For every pairwise experiment we compute the accuracy of seven non-LLM rules on the same pairs: choose the longer (or shorter) solution by character count, the one with (or without) a docstring, the one with (or without) type hints, and the one with more comment lines, with ties scored as one half. Docstrings and type hints are detected with regular expressions (a triple-quoted string; a parameter or return annotation). These baselines answer whether a rule with no access to the model could do as well; since the best rule is chosen on the same items, it is an upper bound on what any one fixed rule achieves. As a reference for how much authorship signal the code itself carries, we also train a classifier (character 2–5-gram TF-IDF features and logistic regression, five-fold cross-validation grouped by task) and let it make the judges’ two-way choice: of two solutions to a task, the one it scores as more likely to be the target’s is assigned to the target. We report Wilson 95% confidence intervals and two-sided exact binomial tests against 50% for accuracies (a normal approximation for balanced accuracy), the rate at which each evaluator picks position A, and position-balanced accuracy, the mean of the accuracies with the evaluator’s own solution in position A and in position B. Stars in tables mark raw p p -values; because each table contains several tests, we also apply the Holm step-down correction within each table (and across all twelve normalized-code results) and state in the text which results survive it. For the self-preference comparison, whose two runs judge the same items, we use an exact McNemar test on the discordant items. For target identification we additionally check, when a judge has been asked about both targets of a pair, whether its two answers form a consistent partition (different positions) and, if so, whether the labels are correct or inverted. A judge answering at random is consistent on half the items; one that separates the two styles but holds the wrong association will be consistent and inverted.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个对偶的实验,我们在同一对上计算七个非LLM规则的准确性:通过字符计数选择更长(或更短)的解决方案,一个有(或没有)docstring,一个有(或没有)类型提示,一个有(或没有)更多评论线,带子得分为一半. Docstrings和类型提示用正则表达式检测(三引字符串;参数或返回注释). 这些基线可以回答一个无法访问模型的规则能否同样做到的问题;由于最佳规则是在同一项目上选择的,因此它是任何固定规则实现的上限. 作为代码本身所携带的多少作者信号的参考,我们也训练了一个分类器(特征2–5克的TF-IDF特性和后勤回归,按任务分组的五倍交叉验证),让法官们双向选择:一个任务的两种解决方案,其得分越有可能被分配给目标. 我们报告 Wilson 95% 的置信间隔和双侧精确二进制测试 50% 的精度( 平衡精确度的正常近似值 ) , 每个评估者选择位置 A 的速率和位置平衡精确度, 与评估者自己在位置 A 和位置 B 的解决方案的速率。 恒星在表格中标出原始的p - 值; 因为每个表格包含若干个测试,我们还在每个表格中(以及所有十二个标准化编码结果)应用Holm 的阶下校正,并在文本中说明其存活下来的结果。 对于自我偏好比较, 二者判断相同的项目, 我们使用一个精确的 McNemar 测试 不协调的项目。 对于目标识别,我们另外检查一下,当法官被问及一对的两个目标时,其两个答案是否形成一个一致的分区(不同的位置),如果是,标签是否正确或倒置. 一个法官随机回答,在一半的项目上是一致的;一个将两种样式分开但持有错误关联的,将是一致的和颠倒的.

blocks.en: 3.4 Normalization
blocks.zh: 3.4 正常化

blocks.en: To test whether the features identified by the baselines can be removed without harming the code, we apply a rule-based normalization to every MBPP solution: remove docstrings and comments, remove type annotations, rename local variables, parameters, and nested functions to v 0 , v 1 , … v_{0},v_{1},\dots , and re-serialize from the AST, which standardizes formatting (example in Appendix E ). Top-level function and class names (which the tests call), imported names, built-ins, attributes, and string literals are kept, so error messages, for example, survive. Four of the 3,084 solutions do not parse (none from a core model) and are only stripped of comments and docstrings; one answer written in Markdown is normalized from its code block. We then re-run the benchmark tests, recompute every heuristic baseline, and re-run the four original pairwise self-recognition runs whose evaluator was still available (all but Grok’s), six target-identification runs, and the self-preference task with the same evaluators, judges, and prompts. Because Grok-Code-Fast-1 had been withdrawn, we also ran a third-party judge, Gemini 2.5 Flash, on Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek on both versions of the code. The target-identification and self-preference reruns keep each item’s A/B order; the pairwise reruns drew a new order, which position-balanced accuracy shows to be immaterial (Section 4.5 ). The reruns were first made with a normalizer that left lambda parameters and nested function names unrenamed, and then with one that broke imports inside function bodies; after each fix we re-judged the judgments whose code had changed (309 of 4,111, and later 58 of 5,396), so all normalized results use the final normalizer.
blocks.zh: 为了测试基线所识别的特性能否在无损代码的情况下被移除,我们对每一个 MBPP 解决方案都应用了基于规则的正常化:去除docstrings and comments,去掉类型说明,将本地变量,参数和嵌入函数重命名为v 0,v_{0},v_{1},\dots}从AST中重新序列化,它实现了格式化(附录E中的例子). 顶级的函数和类名(测试唤来),导入的名称,内置,属性,和字符串的字节都保留下来,因此错误消息,例如,幸存下来. 在3,084个解决方案中,有4个不解析(没有来自核心模型的解析),只有去除评论和docstrings;一个用Markdown写的答案与其代码块实现了正常化. 然后我们重新运行基准测试,重新计算每个高压基线,并重新运行四个原始双向自我识别运行,其评估者仍然可用(除了Grok),6个目标识别运行,以及同一批评估者、法官和提示的自我偏爱任务。 由于Grok-Code-Fast-1已被撤回,我们还在Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek上运行了一名第三方法官,双子座2.5 Flash,两版本的代码. 目标识别和自我偏好重新运行会保持每个项目的A/B顺序;对等重运行会画出一个新的顺序,位置平衡的准确性显示出无关紧要(第4.5节)。 重播先是使用一个让羊肉达参数和嵌入函数名称不改名的规范化器进行,然后用一个使函数机构内部的输入断裂的规范;每次修复后,我们重新判决其代码已经改变的判决(4,111分309分,5,396分58分),所以所有规范化的结果都使用最终规范化器.

blocks.en: Table 1 gives accuracy for every evaluator against every available opponent. In the original runs, in which each model was paired with GPT-5, only GPT-5 itself exceeded chance (81.9% against Grok, p < 10 − 14 p<10^{-14} ); Gemini was at chance, and Grok (41.1%), Claude Haiku (31.5%), and DeepSeek-V3 (30.5%) were significantly below it, attributing GPT-5’s code to themselves. The heuristic baselines account for both outcomes. Every non-empty GPT-5 MBPP solution has a docstring, and the solutions average 18 lines, against 17% and 7 lines for Grok. On GPT-5’s pairs with Grok the rule “choose the longer solution” scores 97.5% and “choose the solution with a docstring” 91.8%, both above GPT-5’s own accuracy, and on the 199 pairs where exactly one solution has a docstring GPT-5 chooses that solution 85.4% of the time. Claude Haiku’s and DeepSeek’s solutions are shorter than GPT-5’s and lack its type hints, and both models nevertheless claim GPT-5’s, which is consistent with the “choose the best-looking answer” behavior Davidson et al. (2024) describe for text. GPT-5 declines to answer on up to 3% of its pairs (“Sorry, I can’t help with that”), as it does more often in the individual task.
blocks.zh: 表1显示每个评价员对每个现有对手的准确性。 在最初的运行中,每个型号都与GPT-5配对,只有GPT-5本身超过了机会(81.9%反对Grok,p < 10 – 14 p < 10^{-14});双子座恰逢机会,而Grok(41.1%),Claude Haiku(31.5%)和DeepSeek-V3(30.5%)则大大低于它,将GPT-5的代码归为自己。 高压基线对这两种结果都有影响。 每个非空格的GPT-5 MBPP溶液都有一个docstring,而Grok的溶液平均有18行,而只有17%和7行. 在GPT-5与Grok的配对上,规则“选择更长的溶液”评分为97.5%,“选择多弦”评分为91.8%,既高于GPT-5本身的准确度,也高于199对完全一个有多弦GPT-5的配对时选择85.4%。 Claude Haiku和DeepSeek的解决方案比GPT-5短,缺乏其类型的提示,但这两个模型都声称是GPT-5,这与Davidson等人的“选择最佳答案”行为是一致的。 (2024)描述文本。 GPT-5拒绝回答高达3%的对数(对不起,我对此无能为力),因为它更经常地在个人任务中回答。

blocks.en: The full matrix shows that this is largely a property of pairs rather than of evaluators. Claude Haiku scores 83.9% against DeepSeek and 31.5% against GPT-5; Gemini scores 81.2% against DeepSeek and 50.0% against GPT-5; DeepSeek, whose solutions are the shortest of the four models in the full matrix, is below chance against every opponent (29.3–31.0%). Eleven of the 14 cells differ from chance after Holm correction; the three that do not are GPT-5 against Claude Haiku and against Gemini, and Gemini against GPT-5, pairs in which both solutions are documented. Across the 14 cells, accuracy correlates with the fraction of pairs in which the evaluator’s own solution is the longer one at Pearson r = 0.93 r=0.93 , with a slope of 0.54: evaluators whose code is longer in 89–97% of pairs score 79–84%, and evaluators whose code is longer in 2–11% of pairs score 29–41%. Since cells share evaluators and items, we treat the correlation as descriptive (leaving out any one evaluator, r = 0.90 r=0.90 –0.96) and check it item by item (Appendix Table 15 ). In 12 of the 14 cells the evaluator picks the longer of the two solutions on 59–87% of items. The exceptions are GPT-5 against Claude Haiku and Gemini, whose solutions are documented like its own; there GPT-5 picks the longer solution about half the time, which suggests that it keys on documentation rather than length. The other four models lean on one rule, that the longer and better documented solution is their own. Within a cell, the evaluator is usually more accurate when its own solution is the longer one (11 of 14 cells; Claude Haiku against GPT-5: 50.6% versus 22.2%). Position bias is also present (DeepSeek chooses position A on 29% of its pairs with GPT-5 and Gemini on 75%), but position-balanced accuracy is within 1.5 points of raw accuracy in every run. A paraphrased prompt shifts the below-chance accuracies by up to ten points without changing their direction, and a repeat run with the original prompt six months later reproduces the aggregate exactly and the individual answer on 97.5% of items shown in the same order (Appendix F , Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 完整的矩阵显示,这主要是一对而非评估者的财产。 Claude Haiku对DeepSeek的分数为83.9%,对GPT-5的分数为31.5%;双子座对DeepSeek的分数为81.2%,对GPT-5的分数为50.0%;DeepSeek的解决方案是全矩阵四个模型中最短的,对每个对手的分数(29.3–31.0%)低于机会. 14个细胞中有11个在霍尔姆修正后与机会不同;3个没有针对克劳德·海库和双子座的GPT-5,还有双子座对GPT-5,两种解决方案都有记载. 在14个单元格中,准确性与对数的分数相关,其中评价者自己的溶液是皮尔森 r = 0.93 r = 0.93的更长的分数,坡度为 0.54:其代码较长的对数为89-97%的评分79-84%,其代码较长的对数为2-11%的评分29-41%。 由于单元格共用评价员和物品,我们把相关性视为描述性(留下任何一个评价员,r = 0.90 r = 0.90 – 0.96),并逐项检查(附录表15)。 在14个单元中的12个单元中,评估人员选择了59-87%的项目上两个解决方案中的更长部分。 例外是GPT-5反对克劳德·海库和双子座,他们的解决方案和它自己的解决方案一样被记录下来;在那里,GPT-5选择了大约一半时间的更长的解决方案,这表明它的关键是文件而不是长度. 其他四个模型依靠一个规则,即长期和更好的文件记载的解决方案是它们自己的. 在细胞内,当自己的溶液是更长的(14个细胞中的11个;Claude Haiku对GPT-5:50.6%对22.2%)时,评价者通常更准确. 位置偏差也存在(DeepSeek在其29%的对格PT-5和75%的双子座上选择位置A),但位置平衡精度在每次运行的1.5点原始精度范围内. 一个被解释的速率将以下的速率移动最多十点而不改变方向,一个与最初的速率在6个月后重复运行,准确地复制了总和和,以及以同样顺序显示的97.5%项目的个别答案(附录F,表8 ).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Individual self-recognition: rate of answering “yes” to “did you generate this code?” when the code is the evaluator’s own (blue) and when it is another core model’s (orange). Recognition would appear as a gap between the two bars; the bars are similar for most models and benchmarks, the largest gap being Grok’s on DS-1000 (89% vs. 72%). Full numbers are in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 图1:个人自我识别:当代码是评估者自己的(蓝色),当它是另一个核心模型的(橙色)时,回答“是”“是否生成这个代码?” 承认会成为两个栏目之间的差距;大多数模型和基准的栏目类似,最大的差距是Grok在DS-1000上的栏目(89%对72%)。 全部数字见附录F。

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the individual-presentation results. For most models and benchmarks, the probability of claiming authorship is similar for the model’s own code and for other models’ code. Balanced accuracy ranges from 49.4% to 58.2% over the 15 combinations (Table 12 gives 95% intervals and raw accuracies). Four cells are above 50% before correction, Grok on HumanEval (54.0%) and DS-1000 (58.2%), Gemini on MBPP (53.8%), and DeepSeek on MBPP (54.4%), and the two Grok cells survive Holm correction. A small amount of signal may therefore exist; the largest value corresponds to yes-rates of 89% and 72%. This matches text, where without fine-tuning the individual setting was near chance for every model but GPT-4 ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) . What differs across models is response policy. GPT-5 never answers “yes” (0 of 1,668 items) and declines to answer on 5–10% of items, typically with a statement that it cannot know whether it generated the code. Claude Haiku says “yes” to at most 6% of items. Grok and Gemini say “yes” to 58–97% of items. DeepSeek is the only model with an intermediate yes-rate on every benchmark, and its gap between own and other code never exceeds 9 points; its few abstentions are degenerate repetitive text rather than refusals. These policies produce raw accuracies from 38% to 67% that would be misread as an ability ranking; Claude Haiku’s 65.7% on MBPP, for example, is below the 66.7% obtained by always answering “no”.
blocks.zh: 图1显示个人介绍结果。 对于大多数模型和基准来说,声称作者身份的可能性对于模型自己的代码和其他模型的代码来说是相似的. 15种组合的平衡精度从49.4%到58.2%不等(表12给出了95%的间隔和原始精度)。 4个细胞在矫正前超过50%,Grok on HumanEval(54.0%)和DS-1000(58.2%),双子细胞在MBPP(53.8%),DeepSeek在MBPP(54.4%),两个Grok细胞在霍尔姆矫正后幸存. 因此,可能存在少量信号;最大值相当于89%和72%的“是”率。 这符合文本,其中除了GPT-4(Panickssery等人,2024年)之外,每个模型几乎都有机会不调整个人设置。 不同模式的不同之处在于反应政策。 GPT-5从未回答"是"(1,668项中的0项),拒绝回答5-10%的项目,一般是用一个声明来表示它不知道是否生成了代码. Claude Haiku表示“是”, Grok和双子座对58-97%的物品表示"是". DeepSeek是唯一一个在每个基准上具有中间是率的模型,它自己的代码和其他代码之间的差距从未超过9点;它的少数弃权是退化的重复文本而不是拒绝. 这些政策产生了38%到67%的原始速率,被误认为是能力排名;例如,Claude Haiku在MBPP上的65.7%低于总回答“不”得到的66.7%。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports attribution to a named model by a third-party judge. The easiest pair is Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek-V3, on which Grok-Code-Fast-1 identifies Claude’s code at 81.6% and DeepSeek’s at 69.0%; the two models also differ strongly in verbosity, and choosing the longer solution scores 89.0% on the same items. Gemini 2.5 Flash on this pair shows what a purely cue-driven judge looks like: it names Claude’s solution as Claude’s (77.3%) and also as DeepSeek’s (DeepSeek accuracy 27.1%), giving the same answer for both targets on 90% of items (Table 14 ). One judge result clearly exceeds every heuristic: on Gemini 2.5 Flash vs. GPT-5, GPT-5.3-Codex identifies Gemini’s code at 76.2% (77.3% position-balanced) while the best rule reaches 52.9%. The same judge identifies Claude Haiku against GPT-5 at 67.2% (best rule 76.1%). Since this judge is a sibling of GPT-5, the result may reflect familiarity with GPT-5’s style rather than with Gemini’s, and Section 4.5 shows that little of it survives normalization. Grok-Code-Fast-1 on Gemini vs. GPT-5 is below chance (40.4%). GPT-5 on Codestral vs. GPT-5.3-Codex also beats its best rule (57.3% vs. 51.0%, not significant after correction), through a cue outside our rule set: Codestral closed 79 of its 257 answers with a second [CODE] marker instead of [/CODE] , leaving a stray marker line in the code, and GPT-5 is right on 72.2% of those items and on 50.0% of the rest.
blocks.zh: 表2报告第三方法官将某种模式归结为指定模式。 最简单的一对是Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek-V3,Grok-Code-Fast-1在其中识别出 Claude的代码为81.6%,DeepSeek的代码为69.0%;两种模式在动词上也存在强烈差异,在相同项目上选择更长的解决方案得分89.0%. 这对双子座2.5闪电显示纯点驱动的判官是什么样子:它将克劳德的解决方案命名为克劳德的(77.3%)和DeepSeek的(DeepSeek精确度27.1%),为90%的项目的两个目标提供了同样的答案(表14)。 一个法官的成绩明显超过每个热度:在双子座2.5 Flash vs. GPT-5,GPT-5.3-Codex识别上 双子座的代码为76.2%(77.3%),最佳规则为52.9%。 同一法官认定Claude Haiku反对GPT-5的比例为67.2%(最佳规则76.1%)。 由于这位法官是GPT-5的兄妹,结果可能反映了对GPT-5风格而不是双子座风格的熟悉,而第4.5节显示,它很少能维持正常化。 双子座对GPT-5上的Grok-Code-Fast-1低于机率(40.4%). GPT-5在Codestral vs. GPT-53-Codex上也打破了它的最佳规则(57.3%对51.0%,在修正后并不重要),通过我们的规则设定以外的一个提示:Codestral用第二个[CODE]标记而不是[/CODE]关闭了它的257个答案中的79个,在代码中留下了一条流浪的标记线,GPT-5在72.2%的这些物品上和其余的50.0%上是正确的.

blocks.en: Two pairs yield below-chance accuracy for every judge and target. On Qwen3-Coder-Next vs. MiMo-V2-Pro, judges score between 39.7% and 43.3% ( p < 0.04 p<0.04 in each of five runs, four of which survive Holm correction). On Claude Opus 4.6 vs. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, GPT-5.3-Codex identifies Opus’s code 7.8% of the time and Gemini’s 31.1%. Position bias cannot produce 7.8%; a systematic wrong mapping can. The consistency analysis (Appendix F , Table 14 ) confirms this reading: a judge answering at random would give complementary answers for the two targets on half the items, and on the Opus/Gemini pair the judge does so on 75.1%, with 68.1% of all items consistent and inverted against 7.0% consistent and correct; on Qwen/MiMo, 44% of items are consistently inverted against 26–29% consistently correct. The judges separate the two styles and attach the names backwards. On the Opus/Gemini pair, Opus’s solutions almost never have docstrings (7 of 257), so the rule “choose the solution without a docstring” identifies them at 98.4%, and the judge instead gives the documented solution to Claude, which matches Claude Haiku 4.5’s habit (98% of its solutions have a docstring) but not Opus’s. The remaining pairs are at or near chance, and position bias is again large for some judges: GPT-5.3-Codex chooses position A on 31–34% of items in two runs and 64% in another, although position-balanced accuracy is within 1.1 points of raw accuracy in every run.
blocks.zh: 每对判官和目标的精度低于两对。 在Qwen3-Coder-Next vs. MiMo-V2-Pro上,评委得分在39.7%至43.3%之间(在5场比赛中每场得分 < 0.04 p<0.04,其中4场在霍尔姆校正中幸存). Claude Opus 4.6 vs. 双子座3.1 Flash Lite上,GPT-5.3-Codex识别 Opus的代码为7.8%的时间和双子座的31.1%. 位置偏差不能产生7.8%;系统的错误绘图可以产生. 一致性分析(Appendix F,表14)证实了这一说法:法官随机回答一半项目的两个目标时会给出补充答案,在Opus/Gemini对子上,法官在75.1%时给出补充答案,所有项目中有68.1%一致,倒数为7.0%,一致和正确;在Quen/MiMo上,44%的项目始终颠倒,26-29%始终正确。 评委将两种风格分开,并将名字向后附加. 在Opus/Gemini配对上,Opus的解决方案几乎从来没有过docstrings(257个中的7个),因此"在没有docstring的情况下选择解决方案"规则将其确定为98.4%,而法官则给出了与克劳德·海库·4.5(英语:Claude Haiku 4.5)的习惯(98%的解决方案有docstring)相符的有文献记载的解决方案,而不是Opus的. 其余的对子都处于或接近概率,位置偏差对于一些评委来说再次很大: GPT-5.3-Codex 选择位置 31-34%的项目分为两期和64%,尽管位置平衡的准确性在每次运行的1.1个原始精确点之内。

blocks.en: Normalization preserves behavior (Appendix F , Table 10 ): Pass@1 is unchanged for all five models, item by item. Docstrings and comments are removed entirely, and mean line counts fall by 16–58%. After normalization many pairs are identical, 7–11% of GPT-5’s pairs and 26–33% of the Claude Haiku/DeepSeek, Opus/Gemini 3.1, and Qwen/MiMo pairs (at most 2% before), so every normalized result below is computed on the pairs that still differ. On the Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek pair, the best heuristic falls from 89.0% to 51.6%. On GPT-5’s pairs with Grok and DeepSeek, the length rule degrades from 94–98% to 85–86% but does not vanish, since GPT-5’s solutions remain structurally longer even without documentation, and against Claude Haiku and Gemini the best rule after normalization (shorter code, 84.0% and 67.9%) is at least as strong as before (Appendix F , Table 17 ). The trained classifier still attributes the normalized code above chance: 93–96% on GPT-5’s pairs and 58–83% on the others, against 74–100% on the original code (Appendix F , Table 16 ).
blocks.zh: 规范化保存行为(Appendix F,表10):Pass@1对所有五个模型,项目逐项不变. Docstrings和评论被完全删除,平均线数下降了16-58%。 常态化后,许多配对是完全相同的,7-11%的GPT-5配对和26-33%的克劳德·海库/DeepSeek,Opus/Gemini 3.1,以及Quen/MiMo配对(此前最多为2 % ) , 所以下面的每个常态化结果都根据仍然不同的配对计算. 在克劳德·海库对战中 DeepSeek配对,最出色的Heuristic从89.0%下降到51.6%. 在GPT-5与Grok和DeepSeek的配对上,长度规则从94-98%下降到85-86%,但并没有消失,因为GPT-5的解决方案在结构上即使没有文件也仍然更长,而对于Claude Haiku和双子座来说,正常化后的最佳规则(较短的代码,84.0%和67.9%)至少和以前一样强大(附录F,表17)。 训练有素的分类人员仍然将规范化的代码归为偶然:GPT-5的对数为93-96%,其他的为58-83%,而原始代码为74-100%(附录F,表16 )。

blocks.en: Table 3 and Appendix Table 11 re-run the evaluators and judges on the normalized code. Ten of the twelve normalized results lie between 43.6% and 57.8%, none significant after Holm correction across the twelve, and position-balanced accuracy is within two points of raw accuracy in every rerun. GPT-5’s pairwise self-recognition falls from 81.9% to 45.2% although the length rule still scores 85.2% on the normalized pairs and the classifier 93.9%, which suggests that GPT-5 was relying on the documentation that accompanies length rather than on length itself, and DeepSeek moves from 30.5% to 56.5%. On target identification, the Gemini judge on Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek moves from 77.3% and 27.1% to 46.5% and 50.3% as the length cue disappears, GPT-5.3-Codex on Gemini vs. GPT-5 drops from 76.2% to 57.8% (nominal p = 0.02 p=0.02 , not significant after correction), and on Claude Haiku vs. GPT-5 from 67.2% to 47.4%; the Qwen vs. MiMo runs move from 41.3% and 41.3% to 43.6% and 49.4%. The two results that stay significant both follow the length difference the normalization leaves. Claude Haiku against GPT-5 scores 35.3% (adjusted p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ): normalization removed the type hints that separated these two models, but Claude Haiku picks the longer solution on 64.5% of pairs, while its own is the longer one on only 16%. On the inverted Opus vs. Gemini 3.1 pair, GPT-5.3-Codex identifies Opus at 39.2% (adjusted p = 0.04 p=0.04 ), far closer to chance than the original 7.8% but still below it, because it gives the longer normalized solution to Opus on 60.5% of pairs although Opus’s is the longer one on only 27%; its accuracy for Gemini 3.1 moves from 31.1% to 45.5%. Wherever normalization removes a surface difference that our rules measure, the zero-shot judges lose the signal that came with it, in whichever direction it pointed, even though the classifier shows that authorship signal remains in the code. These reruns rule out only large residual effects: the 95% intervals of the ten non-significant results extend up to 14 points from chance.
blocks.zh: 表3和附录表11重新对评审员和法官进行规范化代码的管理。 在十二项正常化结果中,有十项在43.6%至57.8%之间,在Holm纠正十二项之后没有重大结果,在每次重播时,位置平衡的准确度在两个原始准确度点之内。 GPT-5的对称自我识别率从81.9%下降到45.2%,尽管长度规则在对称对称和分类器上仍然评分85.2%,93.9%,这表明GPT-5依赖于与长度相伴的文档而不是长度本身,DeepSeek从30.5%移动到56.5%. 在目标识别方面,双子座法官在克劳德·海库诉德国案(Claude Haiku vs. 深度搜索从77.3%和27.1%升至46.5%和50.3%,随着长度提示的消失,双子座对GPT-5上的GPT-5.3-Codex从76.2%降至57.8%(名义p=0.02p=0.02,校正后并不显著),克劳德·海库对GPT-5上的GPT-5从67.2%降至47.4%;Quen vs. MiMo运行率从41.3%和41.3%升至43.6%和49.4%。 保持显著的两个结果都与正常状态的长度差异有关。 Claude Haiku对GPT-5的分数为35.3%(调整后p < 10 - 3 p < 10^{-3}): 正常化消除了分离这两个模型的类型提示,但Claude Haiku在64.5%的对子上选择了更长的溶液,而它自己的只有16%的长度. 在反向Opus对双子座3.1对中,GPT-5.3-Codex识别 欧普斯为39.2%(调整后p=0.04p=0.04),远比原来的7.8%更接近机会,但仍低于机会,因为它给欧普斯60.5%的对子提供了更长的正常化溶液,尽管欧普斯只有27 %;其双子座3.1的精度从31.1%移动到45.5%。 只要正常化消除了我们规则衡量的表面差异,零射的判官就会失去随之而来的信号,无论它指向哪个方向,尽管分类器显示作者的信号仍然留在代码中. 这些重排只排除了巨大的残留影响:10个非重大结果的95%间隔从偶然性延长至14点。

blocks.en: 4.6 Task 3: Blind Self-Preference
blocks.zh: 4.6 任务3:盲人自爱

blocks.en: Table 4: Blind self-preference on MBPP: percentage of items on which X X ’s solution is chosen when X X , a neutral model Z Z , or Y Y judges the same items in the same order. N N is the number of items all three judges answered, excluding empty or identical solutions (after normalization 72, 52, and 37 pairs are identical, 2 of the 72 already before). Δ = Δ X + Δ Y \Delta=\Delta_{X}+\Delta_{Y} is the combined self-preference; Δ X \Delta_{X} and Δ Y \Delta_{Y} are each judge’s preference relative to Z Z . Exact McNemar tests on discordant items: ∗ p < 0.05 {}^{*}p<0.05 , ∗ ∗ ∗ p < 0.001 {}^{***}p<0.001 .

On original code (Table 4 ), the only clear self-preference is Claude Haiku’s against DeepSeek: Claude chooses its own solution 75.2% of the time, while Gemini and DeepSeek, judging the same items, choose Claude’s 63.4% and 64.2%. Claude’s own component is + 11.8 +11.8 points ( p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ) and DeepSeek’s is near zero, and the combined effect is unchanged on items on which both solutions pass or both fail ( + 11.4 +11.4 on 228 items). Much of it is a taste for documentation rather than for its own code: on items where exactly one solution has a docstring, Claude picks the documented one 84% of the time, but as the neutral judge of Gemini vs. DeepSeek it also picks the documented solution 76% of the time, more than Gemini does as the neutral judge here (70%). Against Gemini, whose solutions are also documented, Claude shows no preference ( − 2.7 -2.7 ). On Gemini vs. DeepSeek the combined Δ \Delta of + 4.7 +4.7 is not significant, and its split depends on the neutral judge: Claude Haiku, which favors documented code more than either member of the pair does, makes DeepSeek look self-preferring and Gemini self-averse. Claude’s own component against DeepSeek depends on Gemini’s taste in the same way, so only the combined Δ \Delta is free of the neutral judge. On GPT-5 vs. DeepSeek all three judges choose GPT-5’s solution about 71% of the time. DeepSeek, whose own code is terse, prefers the other model’s solution in every pair (62–72%). Of the 21 tests in the table, three survive Holm correction: Claude’s own component and the combined Δ \Delta against DeepSeek, and DeepSeek’s component relative to Claude Haiku on Gemini vs. DeepSeek. On normalized code no component is significant; Claude’s own component falls to − 1.1 -1.1 and the combined Δ \Delta against DeepSeek to + 4.3 +4.3 . To the extent that self-preference exists in this setting, it resides in the same removable surface features as self-recognition.
blocks.zh: 在原始代码(表4)上,唯一明显的自我偏爱是克劳德·海库(Claude Haiku)反对DeepSeek: 克劳德在75.2%的时间里选择了自己的解决方案,而双子座和DeepSeek在判断相同的项目时选择了克劳德的63.4%和64.2%. 克劳德自己的构件是+11.8+11.8分(p < 10 - 3 p < 10 - 3 > ),DeepSeek的构件接近零,对两个解决方案都通过或都失败的项目(在228个项目上+11.4+11.4)的综合影响没有变化. 克劳德选择了84%的文献记录, DeepSeek还选择了76%的时间里记录下来的解决方案,比双子座作为这里的中立裁判(70%)还要多. Claude反对双子星,因为双子星的解决方案也有文献记载,但克洛德没有表现出任何偏好(−2.7-2.7). 在双子座对DeepSeek上,+4.7+4.7的Q&Delta组合并不显著,其分裂取决于中立法官: 克劳德·海库(Claude Haiku)比对子中任何一个成员都更偏爱记录代码,使得DeepSeek看起来更自我偏好和双子座自我厌恶. Claude本身对抗DeepSeek的成分, 在GPT-5对DeepSeek案中,所有三名法官都选择了GPT-5的解决方案,时间约为71%. DeepSeek,它自己的代码是terse,更喜欢每对(62–72 %)中另一个模型的解决方案. 在表中的21项测试中,有3项在霍尔姆校正中存活: Claude自己的构件以及联合的\\Delta对抗DeepSeek,以及DeepSeek的构件相对于Claude Haiku在双子座对DeepSeek. 在规范化代码中,没有重要组件;克劳德自己的组件降为−1.1-1.1,合并的\\Delta对DeepSeek为+4.3+4.3。 只要在此情况下存在自我偏爱,它就与自我承认一样,存在于可移动的表面特征中。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The above-chance results in this study are largely explained by a small number of surface features. The one result that clearly exceeded our heuristics, GPT-5.3-Codex on Gemini vs. GPT-5, falls from 76.2% to a non-significant 57.8% once docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names are removed; the one other result that beat its best rule came from stray answer-format markers; and the two normalized results that stay significant follow the length difference that normalization leaves. The individual-presentation task, which removes the contrast between two solutions and with it the relative cues, never exceeds 58.2% balanced accuracy. This agrees with Davidson et al. (2024) , Bai et al. (2025) , and St. Amand et al. (2026) and extends them to a setting in which the authorship signal is strong and measurable: a simple trained classifier still separates GPT-5’s normalized code from other models’ code at 93–96%, while no zero-shot judge does better than 58% on those pairs. The signal exists in the code; asking a model whether the code is its own does not reach it.
blocks.zh: 本研究的上述成绩主要由少量表面特征来解释. 其中一项结果显然超越了我们的修炼,即双子座对GPT-5上的GPT-5.3-Codex,一旦标注、评论、类型提示和本地名称被删除,则从76.2%下降到无显著的57.8%;另一项胜过其最佳规则的结果来自偏差的答案格式标记;以及两项保持显著的正常化结果与正常化留下的长度差异。 个人介绍任务消除了两个解决方案之间的对比,与之相对的提示,从未超过58.2%的均衡精确度. 这与Davidson等人(2024年)、Bai等人(2025年)和St. Amand等人(2026年)的观点一致,并扩展到作者的信号强大和可测量的场所:一个简单的训练有素的分类器仍然将GPT-5的规范化代码与其他型号的代码93–96%区分开来,而在这些配对上,没有哪个零镜头裁判能比58%好. 信号存在于代码中;询问一个模型代码是否是自己的代码不会到达它.

blocks.en: A single accuracy for yes/no self-recognition is uninterpretable without the two yes-rates: our data contain a model with a 0% true-positive rate scoring 61–66% and one with a 97% true-positive rate scoring 40%, so a study that reports one number per model ranks models by their response policy.
blocks.zh: 没有两个“是”/“无”自我识别的单一准确性是无法解释的:我们的数据包含一个模型,真实阳性率为0%,得分61–66 %,一个真实阳性率为97%,得分40 %,因此一项研究根据每个模型的响应政策报告一个数字。

blocks.en: The consistent inversions in target identification show judges that can separate two coding styles yet attach the wrong label. Two explanations fit. One is a stereotype about the named family: Claude Haiku 4.5 documents 98% of its MBPP solutions, so “Claude writes docstrings” is a reasonable belief that happens to be false for Opus 4.6 under our prompt. The other is a quality prior tied to the name, such as giving the more polished solution to the model the judge believes is stronger, the attribution counterpart of the quality heuristic of St. Amand et al. (2026) . A quality heuristic that ignores the name cannot produce consistent inversions: our Gemini judge on Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek, which gives the longer, documented solution to whichever model is named as the target, gives the same answer for both targets and is consistent on only 10% of items. Inversions are not a general property of recent models (DeepSeek-V3.2 vs. MiMo and the Codestral pairs are at or near chance), and our design cannot separate the two explanations; after normalization the judge on the Opus pair still gives the longer solution to Claude, which either would predict. Either way, below-chance accuracy is informative and should not be averaged into “near chance”: it is evidence of discrimination ability combined with a mislabeled prior.
blocks.zh: 目标识别中一致的反演显示判断可以将两种编码样式分开,但附加错误的标签. 两个解释是合适的。 一个是刻板印象, Claude Haiku 4.5 记录了98%的MBPP解决方案, 因此“Claude write docstrings”是一个合理的信念, 另一种是先与名称捆绑的质素,比如给模型提供法官认为更光泽的溶液更强,是St. Amand et al.(2026)的质量heuristic的归属对应物. 一个无视这个名字的质的heuristic不能产生一致的反演:我们的双子座法官在克劳德·海库(Claude Haiku)对DeepSeek(DeepSeek)案中给出了更长的,有文件记载的解决方案,对于任何被命名为目标的模型,两个目标都给出了相同的答案,并且只在10%的项目上一致. 反转不是近代模型的一般属性(DeepSeek-V3.2 vs. MiMo and the Codestral pairs are at or almost happenance),我们的设计无法将两种解释分开;在正常化后,Opus配对上的裁判仍然给克劳德提供更长的解决方案,后者也会预测. 无论哪种方式,不足的准确性都具有信息性,不应被平均为“近乎机会”:这是歧视能力的证据,加上先前贴错了标签。

blocks.en: For untrusted monitoring ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) , the results are moderately reassuring about the models we tested, in a zero-shot setting. A monitor cannot reliably tell whether a snippet came from itself, and the one clear self-preference is modest and tied to surface features. Three caveats remain. Verbosity and documentation cues are strong enough that a monitor can distinguish some pairs of models, and a generator could amplify such cues deliberately as a signal; fine-tuning raises self-recognition substantially, in text ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) and for code monitors even with comments stripped ( Gardner-Challis et al., 2026 ) ; and most of our evaluators are small or fast models, while in text the most capable model recognized itself best ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) . Redacting code before it reaches the monitor, as AI-control protocols already do, removes the first channel at little cost to correctness, but it is not anonymization: our classifier still attributes normalized code, and our Claude Haiku vs. GPT-5 result shows that the length signal it leaves still drives zero-shot judgments.
blocks.zh: 对于不可信的监测(Greenblatt等人,2024年),结果对于我们测试的模型,在零镜头的环境下,是相当令人放心的。 监视器无法可靠地判断片段是否来自自身,而清晰的自我偏好是谦虚的,与表面特征相连. 仍有三个告诫。 Verbosery和文档提示足够强大,显示器可以区分一些模型,一个生成器可以故意将这种提示放大为信号;微调在文字(Panickssery等人,2024年;Zhou等人,2025年)和代码显示器中大大提高了自我识别度,即使有被剥去的评论(Gardner-Challis等人,2026年)也是如此;我们大多数的评价员是小型或快速的模型,而在文字中最有能力的模型被公认为最好(Panicksery等人,2024年)。 如AI控制协议已经做的那样,在到达显示器前重排代码,去掉第一个通道,而费用很少,以进行校正,但它不是匿名化:我们的分类器仍然属性归正代码,我们的Claude Haiku vs. GPT-5的结果表明它留下的长度信号仍然驱动零镜头判断.

blocks.en: We therefore suggest that self-recognition and attribution studies report balanced accuracy and both yes-rates for individual paradigms, heuristic baselines on the same items, position rates with name order randomized independently of position, and label consistency where both targets of a pair are run. They should also parse answers strictly, so that refusals are not read as choices, and check how many pairs a transformation makes identical before reading its results as chance.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们建议,自我识别和归属研究应报告均衡的准确性,以及个人范式的 " 是 " 率、同一项目上的 " 热度 " 基线、名称顺序的定位率与位置无关的随机化以及两个对目标运行时的标签一致性。 他们也应该严格分析答案,这样拒绝不被解读为选择,在将结果解读为机会之前,检查一次变换使多少对相同.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We asked whether current language models can recognize their own code or attribute code to a named model without training. In the individual setting they largely cannot: balanced accuracy is at most 58% for every model and benchmark, and raw accuracies reflect response policy. In the pairwise setting, accuracy across evaluator–opponent pairs is largely a function of whose solution is longer rather than of the evaluator. Attribution to a named model succeeds for some pairs and is consistently backwards for others, which points to stereotypes or name-dependent priors rather than knowledge of the named model’s style. A simple AST normalization preserves correctness and removes most of the signal the judges used, along with the one clear self-preference effect, even though a trained classifier can still attribute the normalized code. We release all generations, judgments, and analysis code.
blocks.zh: 我们问,目前的语言模型是否可以识别自己的代码,或者不经过培训就将代码归属给一个被命名的模型。 在个人设定中,它们基本上无法做到:每个模型和基准的均衡准确度最多为58%,原始的精确度反映了反应政策。 在对偶的设定中,各对评价者的准确性主要是其解决办法更长而不是评价者的准确性。 对一个被命名的模型的归属对于一些对子来说是成功的,对于其他对子来说是一贯的后退,这说明刻板印象或依赖名称的前科,而不是对被命名的模型风格的了解. 简单的AST正常化可以保持正确性,并去除大多数评委使用的信号,以及一种明显的自我偏好效果,尽管受过训练的分类员仍然可以将正常化的代码归属. 我们发布所有世代 判断和分析代码。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The study is zero-shot and black-box, and says nothing about what could be recovered by fine-tuning or probing. Only one evaluator, GPT-5, is a flagship model; the others are small, fast, or older open-weight models, and in text self-recognition improved with capability ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) , so stronger models may do better. Each judgment is a single binary answer, and graded confidence or token probabilities would allow threshold-free measures such as AUC, which matter for evaluators like GPT-5 that never answer “yes”. Task 1a covers all pairs among the four core models still available but only one pair for Grok, and the individual task uses two “other” models per evaluator. Target identification covers 17 judge–pair–target combinations on one benchmark; symmetric judge sets on each pair would strengthen the inversion finding, and some generators were released close to or after the judges, so for those pairs only family-level knowledge is testable. The normalization removes all cues at once, so it does not show which cue each judge relied on, and code with generic names may look unlike any model’s output; an ablation that removes one cue at a time would separate these. The reruns on normalized code cover four of the five core evaluators and eight target-identification runs, selected for informativeness under a fixed budget, and the Grok models were withdrawn from the API before the reruns. For Task 1a and every Task 2 judge except Gemini 2.5 Flash, the original and normalized runs are six months apart, and only one evaluator has a same-prompt repeat. GPT-5’s empty outputs remove 16 of 257 MBPP items from every pair involving GPT-5. The self-preference experiment covers four pairs with a single quality prompt, and the split of Δ \Delta between the two judges depends on the neutral judge’s own taste. The HumanEval and DS-1000 generation prompts request a docstring or comments and descriptive names, which narrows stylistic differences on those benchmarks, and the core models’ MBPP solutions average 7–20 lines, far shorter than the code a monitor reviews in practice. All results concern Python and specific model versions accessed through OpenRouter between March and September 2026, without pinning a hosting provider. Each item was judged once, at temperature 0 where the model supports it, with one prompt phrasing per task; Appendix F reports a paraphrased-prompt and repeat-run check for Task 1a, but the response policies we observe in Task 1b are likely to be sensitive to prompt wording and to model updates.
blocks.zh: 研究是零镜头和黑盒,对通过微调或探测可以回收的事物没有任何说法. 只有一位评价员GPT-5是旗舰型号;其他则是小型,快速,或更古老的开放量级型号,在文本中随着能力提高自我识别(Panikssery et al., 2024),因此更强大的型号可能做得更好. 每项判断都是单一的二进制答案,分级的信心或象征性概率将允许无阈值措施,如AUC,对于GPT-5等从未回答“是”的评价者来说,这一点很重要。 任务1a涵盖仍然可用的四个核心模型中的所有配对,但Grok只能使用一对配对,单项任务使用每个评价员的两个“其他”模型。 目标识别涵盖一个基准上的17个法官-陪审员-目标组合;每对对一对对对称法官的组合将加强反演发现,一些发电机在法官附近或之后释放,因此,对于这些对一对法官来说,只有家庭层面的知识是可测试的。 正常化会同时删除所有提示, 所以它不会显示每个法官所依赖的提示, 并且带有通用名称的代码可能看起来与任何模型的输出不同; 一次去掉一个提示的衰减会把这些分开 。 关于规范化代码的重播涵盖了5个核心评价员中的4个和8个目标识别运行,在固定预算下选择信息化,格罗克模型在重播前退出API. 对于任务1a和除双子座2.5 Flash之外的每个任务2裁判,原运行和常态运行相隔6个月,只有一位评价员具有相同的瞬间重复. GPT-5的空输出从每对涉及GPT-5的257 MBPP项目中移除16个. 自我首选实验涵盖四对,单质的提示,两位裁判的QQ\Delta的分割取决于中立裁判自己的品味. HumanEval和DS-1000一代的提示请求一个注释或评论和描述性名称,这缩小了这些基准上的形式差异,核心模型的MBPP解决方案平均为7-20行,比代码要短得多,实际上是一个监视器审查。 所有结果都涉及Python和2026年3月至9月通过OpenRouter访问的特定模型版本,没有给一个主机供应商打针. 每个项目都经过过一次判断,在模型支持它的0温度下,每个任务都有一个即时措辞;附录F报告为任务1a进行一个解译-即时和重复运行检查,但是我们在任务1b中观察到的反应政策很可能对快速措辞和模型更新敏感.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies whether language models can identify code authorship in order to assess a prerequisite for evaluator bias and collusion in model-based oversight. The normalization we evaluate is a standard rule-based code transformation and does not enable misuse beyond what existing obfuscators already provide. All code was generated for public benchmarks; no human-authored private code was involved.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究语言模型能否确定代码的作者身份,以评估评价者在模型监督中存在偏见和串通的先决条件。 我们评价的正常化是一种标准的基于规则的代码转换,除了现有的混淆者已经提供的内容之外,不会造成滥用。 所有代码都是为公共基准生成的;没有涉及人类授权的私人代码。

blocks.en: Appendix B The Name-Order Confound
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: An earlier version of the Task 2 prompt read “One solution was written by {{model1}}, and the other by {{model2}} (order is randomized)”, where model1 was always the author of Solution A. Solution order was randomized, but name order moved with it, so the first name mentioned always wrote Solution A. Ten runs were made with this prompt or an earlier revision of it before the problem was noticed (Table 5 ). Eight show accuracies of 86–99%; on Claude Haiku vs. DeepSeek-V3 these are well above the post-fix runs on the same pair (81.6% and 69.0%), and four of them exceed the strongest heuristic (89.0%). The other two are far below chance (19.9% and 31.0%), consistent with those judges applying the inverse shortcut. We report these runs only to document the hazard; all Task 2 results in the main text use the corrected prompt, in which name order is randomized independently of solution order. A variant of Task 2 in which the judge labels both solutions was run only with the earlier prompt and is excluded.
